Chaka Garbutt, Secretary  Arthur Romo, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 1:00 PM, Chair Vuong called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Dean, Hope, Romo, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams, Vuong

Commissioners Absent: Gonzalez

Also present: Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk
Specialist.

Commissioner Gonzalez is excused from the meeting.

 Chair Vuong spoke.

 Vice Chair Adams joined the meeting.

 Commissioner Hope spoke.

 Jennifer Kumiyama, Citywide Accessibility Coordinator, City Manager Department, spoke.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-53984  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens' Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, December 12, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Swanson, seconded by Commissioner
  Dean, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Dean, Romo, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams, Vuong
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 1  Hope

2.  25-54306  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Long Beach Police
  Department Staff regarding the Long Beach Special Alerts Program.

  A motion was made by Secretary Garbutt, seconded by Commissioner
  Swanson, to approve recommendation, as amended, to request that Police
  Department staff report back to the Commission with specific demographics
  of calls for service and of people with disabilities. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Dean, Hope, Romo, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams, Vuong
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Gonzalez

  Allison Gallagher, Executive Communications Officer, Police Department, spoke;
  and provided a PowerPoint presentation.

3.  25-53985  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Dean, seconded by Commissioner
  Hope, to approve recommendation, as amended, to dissolve the Access
  Mapping Ad Hoc Committee; create the National Disability Employment
  Awareness Month Ad Hoc Committee, members include Commissioner Dean,
  Commissioner Hope, and Chair Vuong; and create the CACoD Disability
  Advocates of the Year Awards Ad Hoc Committee, members include
  Commissioner Gonzalez, Secretary Garbutt, and Vice Chair Adams. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Dean, Hope, Romo, Swanson, Garbutt, Adams, Vuong
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Gonzalez
